name: HH breakout 11 — opening-range breakout, ORB module (15m)
rationale: MECHANISM: crypto volume is NOT uniform across 24h — the US cash open and the Europe-US overlap concentrate order flow (>$5B in the first 45 min at US open), and the first burst of directional volume tends to set the session tone. The counterparty is overnight/Asia-session range-traders and passive LPs whose quotes get swept when Western institutional flow arrives. We use the dedicated OpeningRangeBreakout module (setup.orb): range_bars defines the opening-range window and buffer is the fitted break-above margin (both ParamRefs). We require vol_realized RISING (above a fitted floor — real participation, not a dead-session drift) so the break is backed by genuine flow. Distinct from all channel/squeeze variants because the trigger is the ORB structural module, not a raw range_position threshold. bar_size 15m. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if the ORB break shows no edge over the SAME break fired at a random hour (the time/opening-range anchor adds nothing — the US-open effect has bled into 24/7 crypto), OR if the edge exists only for BTC/ETH and evaporates on alts per-symbol, OR if the vol_realized rising-participation filter is decorative (removing it does not degrade the edge).
catalyst: break above the opening-range high with rising participation
